data.name: WhyUsText
data.value: About us and why choose us?

data.name: Experience2Text
data.value: Rentoom Apartments is a modern brand managing short-term rentals in Toruń. Over 100 investors have already placed their trust in us. We manage more than 150 apartments and handle over 7,000 bookings annually.

data.name: QualityText2
data.value: We handle the entire process—from professional apartment preparation and effective promotion to dynamic pricing management, 24/7 guest service, cleaning, and technical maintenance. We ensure clear accounting and full financial transparency.

data.name: Professionalism2
data.value: Thanks to our experience and a proven business model, it is possible to achieve annual revenues reaching as much as 30% of the property's value*.

data.name: InnovationText2
data.value: Additionally, our Partner Program, which offers discounts to restaurants and attractions in Toruń, enhances the appeal of the apartments and boosts their occupancy rates.

data.name: Maintenance-freeInvestmentText2
data.value: The service we offer is comprehensive. You can sleep soundly; we do the work for you.

data.name: IncomeOptimizationText2
data.value: We constantly monitor the market and adjust rental prices to maximize your profit.

data.name: ReadyToHelpText2
data.value: We guarantee our mutual clients support twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.

data.name: Coop_Faq1_A
data.value: The standard model is 80/20 — 80% of the net income goes to the owner, 20% is the Rentoom commission. We cover the commissions of portals (Booking, Airbnb) from our part.

data.name: Coop_Faq2_Q
data.value: How long do we sign the contract?

data.name: Coop_Faq2_A
data.value: The contract is indefinite with a 1-month notice period. We don't commit for years — we prefer you to stay because it pays off for you.

data.name: Coop_Faq3_Q
data.value: Do I need to renovate my apartment?

data.name: Coop_Faq3_A
data.value: Not always. During the audit, we check the technical condition and give a list of recommendations. Sometimes home staging and minor tweaks are enough, and sometimes we offer a makeover — but the decision is always yours.

data.name: Coop_Faq4_Q
data.value: Who pays for cleaning and laundry?

data.name: Coop_Faq4_A
data.value: The cost of cleaning is included in the reservation price and is covered by the guest. Laundry (bed linen, towels) is a fixed operating cost included in the settlement.

data.name: Coop_Faq5_Q
data.value: What if the guest destroys something?

data.name: Coop_Faq5_A
data.value: Every stay is documented. We are applying for compensation from the bail or portal protection program. We also advise on appropriate property insurance.

data.name: Coop_Faq6_Q
data.value: Can I use the apartment privately?

data.name: Coop_Faq6_A
data.value: Yes. All you have to do is block the appointment in the calendar well in advance. Your apartment, your rules.

data.name: Coop_Faq7_Q
data.value: What does the settlement look like?

data.name: Coop_Faq7_A
data.value: Every month, you get a detailed report with a list of bookings, costs, and payout. One PDF, readable for you and your accountant.

data.value: We will come, see the premises and prepare a forecast of income with a fork. No fees and no obligation.
